mean_center.description: Whether the data was centered on the column MEAN. False when robust scaling was used: that centers on the median instead, which robust_scale records. False does not by itself mean the data was uncentered -- check robust_scale.

standard_scale.description: Whether the data was divided by the column standard deviation. This says nothing about centering: standard scaling without centering is reachable (--no-mean-centering --scale standard), so read mean_center separately. Mutually exclusive with robust_scale and scale_only.

robust_scale.description: Whether robust scaling was applied: (x - median) / MAD. This CENTERS ON THE MEDIAN as well as scaling, so a model with robust_scale true is centered even though mean_center is false. Mutually exclusive with standard_scale and scale_only.

scale_only.description: Whether the data was divided by the column standard deviation WITHOUT any centering. Mutually exclusive with standard_scale and robust_scale.

snv.description: Whether Standard Normal Variate (row-wise normalization) was applied

oneOf.description: No filter was applied. This is also how models written before the filter existed read, since the field is absent from them.
An enabled filter. The window must be odd so it has a center, and at least 3.

savgol_window.description: Savitzky-Golay sliding window length in variables. Either zero, meaning no filter, or an odd length of at least 3 that is also greater than savgol_polyorder. The relation to savgol_polyorder cannot be expressed here and is checked when the filter is rebuilt.

savgol_polyorder.description: Degree of the polynomial fitted within each Savitzky-Golay window. Meaningful only when savgol_window is greater than zero.

savgol_deriv.description: Savitzky-Golay derivative order: 0 smooths without differentiating, 1 and 2 take the first and second derivative. Must not exceed savgol_polyorder. Meaningful only when savgol_window is greater than zero.

feature_mads.description: Column-wise median absolute deviations for robust scaling

row_stddevs.description: Row-wise standard deviations for SNV preprocessing
